clips.title: The story
paras: Whitereach Post is a small Horde encampment nestled along the dusty canyon path in Thousand Needles. Serving as a minor waystation near Camp E'thok, it offers respite and watchful eyes over the harsh desert highway. For travelers moving between Feralas and the salt flats, it stands as an outpost of Horde safety beneath the looming sandstone pillars.

Perched along the beaten path winding through the depths of Thousand Needles, Whitereach Post is one of several modest Horde footholds carved out of the rugged landscape. Stationed in close proximity to Camp E'thok, the post helps maintain a reliable presence along the canyon floor, monitoring travel between the windswept mesas. While not as fortified as the great lift or major tribal settlements, it serves as an indispensable stop for couriers, scouts, and adventurers traversing the contested wastes.
